assumptions: Physical access to the NVIDIA Jetson board is available to the attacker.
Direct read/write access across system address space can be reliably turned into code execution and scope extension.
The host environment runs an affected Jetson Linux version prior to 32.7.1 on supported hardware.

evidence_quotes.quote: an unprivileged attacker with physical access to the board direct read/write access to the entire system address space through the PCI bus
could result in denial of service, code execution, escalation of privileges, and impact to data integrity and confidentiality
The scope impact may extend to other components.

missing_conditions: Physical access to the target hardware board
Verification of Jetson Linux version prior to 32.7.1 on affected Jetson Nano hardware
Specific exploit mechanism to translate PCI bus DMA memory access into arbitrary code execution
response.reason: CVE-2022-21819 notes that IOMMU misconfiguration 'may allow an unprivileged attacker with physical access to the board direct read/write access to the entire system address space through the PCI bus', and that this attack 'could result in denial of service, code execution, escalation of privileges, and impact to data integrity and confidentiality' while 'The scope impact may extend to other components.' The edge models the progression from raw DMA access to code execution and scope extension within the same CVE, which is causally consistent with the description's stated potential impacts, but remains conditional upon physical access, deployment on affected hardware/software, and reliable execution exploitation.
